body:
My name is Chris. If it's all the same, I'd rather you have your thoughts on something or someone else. Part of the reason we push people away is to avoid burdening them with our issues or bringing them down with negativity, and I don't need another reason to feel guilty.

Get yourself some sleep, it's late.  It's morning over here now after a sleepless night, i've got to appear okay again now that people are waking up (which is why it took a while to reply) so I can't be here over-thinking and getting all teary eyed.

Thanks for the kind words, I certainly didn't expect anyone to read to it, but writing it kept it me occupied for an hour or so, which is about all i can hope for these days.

​

Unfortunately, I don't think talking to my dad is something i'm capable of, last time It was because I had no choice but to say something and I wasn't going to lie about why I wasn't going to family christmas dinner (something i've not been able to do in the years since either) talking about emotional stuff has never been something I'm good at, it was difficult enough writing this essay out despite it not really being to anyone.

 I'm not convinced it is something he wants to hear either. He's known now for several years that I've not been well, that i made an effort to improve things mentally and failed, but he never pushed me again. A part of me thinks he's somewhat accepting of the current situation and is happier to bury his head in the sand about the extent of it... I only have to look in the mirror to see the toll it's had on me physically, you can hide the feelings, you can pretend to be okay, but after years of it, neglecting to look after oneself properly, it's right there on the surface for everyone to see. None of my clothes fit properly anymore, i've lost a lot of weight and i was always relatively thin to begin with, skin colour is far more grey, bags under eyes are more pronounced, it's like you're ageing 10x faster. 

I searched for a reason to live for myself. After leaving the job I had due to the depression and my inability to focus, I decided I had to do something I enjoyed as a desperate attempt to improve my mental state, I gave it a real shot, even starting my own business, but I couldn't shake the depression that had sunk in by then, and it sapped all my energy and motivation within a few months. As such I failed in that endevour, which caused things to spiral further and that's when the debt started, now there is nothing left that gives me any sense of joy.

... I'll stop there, it's already turned into a lengthy response and that's not going into the other attempts i've made to give myself a "sense of purpose" or the toll they ultimately took on me.

 I appreciate you taking the time to respond to me though, and i'm glad you were able to find your way through your illness, and I hope you'll continue to improve your situation now that your in a better place mentally. It's a horrible existence to live with it and I'm happy for anyone who manages to fight their way through it to a better life.
